dnsbl_version.description: Version identifier embedded in the DNS response (e.g., for daemon identification). Leave blank to omit.

log_file.description: Path to the log file. Use '-' to log to stdout (useful with systemd).

pid_file.description: Path where the daemon writes its PID file.

service_user.description: Unix username under which the daemon will run (for security).

service_group.description: Unix group name for the daemon (optional; pairs with `service_user`).

listen_addresses.description: List of IP addresses (IPv4 or IPv6) to bind the DNS server to. Use '127.0.0.1' for loopback-only, or '0.0.0.0' to listen on all interfaces.

listen_port.description: DNS port used for all listen addresses unless overridden per-address in `listen_addresses`.

zones.description: List of DNSBL zones to serve. Each entry defines a zone and its SOA/RR behavior.
